methodologyNote: Measured via social media referrals in tracked traffic.

aiSummary: In October 2026, Facebook led social media (mobile) in Kenya at 36.25% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Twitter ranked second at 24.41%, followed by YouTube at 21.75%.

faqs.question: Which item leads social media (mobile) in Kenya?
faqs.answer: Facebook leads at 36.25% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/social-media-stats/mobile/kenya.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.
